snippet.title: Flock Off! IGN Live Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3021550/Flock_Off/
Join the Flock Off! Discord https://discord.gg/k7j4J5YPCG

Flock Off! is a 1-4 player co-op PvE game that drops players into an alternate reality Scotland in the early 90’s. A scientific experiment to clone sheep has gone horribly awry, leading to what is being locally referred to as the "undead zombie sheep uprising". With herds of vicious livestock roaming the Highlands looking for their next victim, players must arm themselves with anything they can - bedrolls, traffic cones, chainsaws, their friend Paul - as they battle wave upon wave of monstrous sheep, lamas, highland cows, and other ferocious (now undead) livestock.
